summary: Contracts and FULL-implemented backend pieces (identity register/login/refresh, catalog product list/detail/create, inventory stock.read + reservation.create + reservation.release + payment.completed consumer + sweeper, cart add-item/read/update-item, checkout preview/commit with all 9 orchestration steps + §11.2 pricing tier, order create-from-checkout/detail/list-mine + payment.completed consumer, payment intent.create/simulate/callback with strict (intentId,providerStatus) dedup + outbox emission of completed/failed/expired) wire the §7.1 happy-path spine end-to-end at the backend layer for register -> login -> browse -> add-to-cart -> checkout -> payment-success -> order-detail-PAID. Contracts cover every documented BA AC; cross-service handoffs (cart->catalog/inventory, checkout->cart/catalog/inventory/order/payment, payment->order/inventory via Kafka events, order->inventory via order.cancelled event) are bidirectionally specified with the locked PR-001 sweeper, PR-003 state-driven consumer pattern, and PR-004 cookie<->Bearer flow. However, three blocks of run-scope STUBs are spine-load-bearing rather than peripheral: (1) a single cross-cutting Reviewer-fix gap leaves traceId out of every service's wire envelope (cross-cutting.response-envelope failure across all 7 services); (2) the FAILED/TIMEOUT branches of the spine are not observable end-to-end because Order's onPaymentFailed/onPaymentExpired/onReservationExpired/onOrderCancelled consumers and Inventory's payment.failed/expired/order.cancelled consumers are TODO-stubs (Payment's outbox publishes the events correctly, but no consumer transitions Order or releases stock), so PAY-003/PAY-004/INV-006/ORD-004/ORD-005/ORD-006 land on stubs that BA success_conditions claim 1 and 2 explicitly require; (3) the frontend /checkout and /checkout/payment pages are STUBS, so the end-to-end frontend journey AC (register->login->browse->add->checkout->pay->order detail) cannot run through the UI in this scaffold. These are run-scope decisions per ADVISORY/run-log, but they collide with BA success_conditions; routing as criteria_unmet to Dev (cap 2) for the spine-load-bearing un-stubs and Tech-Lead has no contract violation to address (the contracts are correct).

system_observations: Spine end-to-end at the BACKEND layer (register -> login -> list -> detail -> cart.add -> cart.read -> checkout.preview -> checkout.commit -> payment.simulate(SUCCESS) -> order.detail-PAID) is FULL and covers BA success_conditions item (1) when driven via direct API calls. The blockers for the full BA success_conditions are cart.clear-on-checkout (CU-002), the order/inventory failure-branch consumers (CU-003/CU-004 for items 2 and 3), the admin transitions (CU-003 for item 3), and the frontend UI shells (CU-005 for items 1 driven by the UI).

Contract conformance at boundaries: cart->catalog (FULL via cart/client_catalog.go), cart->inventory (FULL on bulk-read but inventory side is STUB so cart's checkoutable flag falls back to inventoryStatus=CATALOG_UNREACHABLE), checkout->cart (FULL on cart.read but STUB on cart.clear-on-checkout), checkout->catalog (FULL), checkout->inventory (FULL on reservation.create + bulk-read graceful-degraded), checkout->order create-from-checkout (FULL with internal-secret middleware), checkout->payment intent.create (FULL), payment->order via events.payment.completed (FULL), payment->inventory via events.payment.completed (FULL), payment->order via events.payment.failed/expired (PRODUCER FULL but CONSUMER STUB on both order and inventory), order->inventory via events.order.cancelled (PRODUCER STUB on order admin/customer-cancel, CONSUMER STUB on inventory). Five of ten boundaries are fully satisfied bidirectionally; five are producer-or-consumer-stubbed.

Error code registry alignment: every spotted handler uses codes from cross-cutting.error-codes registry (CodeValidationError, CodeAddressNotOwned, CodeAddressIncomplete, CodeInsufficientStock, CodeUpstreamTimeout, CodeDBUnavailable, CodeProductInactive/Deleted, CodeIdempotencyKeyReused, CodeAuthInvalid, CodeAuthForbidden, CodeDuplicateEmail/SKU, CodePaymentAmountMismatch, CodeNotFound). One non-registry code observed in stubs: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED_MVP' (not in registry). Acceptable as scope marker but worth promoting to registry as 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED_MVP' for stub-aware clients.

Route convention: all backend services follow POST /api/v1/{domain}/{aggregate}/{action}. Identity uses /api/v1/identity/auth/{action} where contract examples list /api/v1/identity/user/{action}; the rule itself (domain/aggregate-boundary/action) is satisfied -- 'auth' is a valid aggregate-boundary -- so this is an example-vs-implementation drift, not a rule violation. Tracked as observation only.

PR-001 sweeper, PR-003 state-driven cross-topic disambiguation, PR-004 cookie<->Bearer 6-step flow, PR-007 frontend complexity tag are all reflected in code. PR-002 §11.2 pricing tier: pricing.go single-source verified.

Repair-cycle items (identity bcrypt switch, inventory two-phase lock-order + auth split, order const-time compare, checkout INSERT ON CONFLICT) are all confirmed landed in code per the run-log. No regressions observed in the spot-check.

Cross-cutting traceId omission (CU-001) is the single-edit fix that would lift response-envelope conformance from partial to full across all 7 services. Recommend Reviewer-L2 confirms this is on the Dev queue ahead of CU-003/CU-004.
